title: PROC COMPARE : BY, METHOD=ABSOLUTE, CRITERION=, OUT= OUTDIF OUTNOEQUAL (seules les paires jugees inegales sont ecrites)

provenance.source: https://documentation.sas.com/api/collections/pgmsascdc/9.4_3.5/docsets/proc/content/proc.pdf?locale=en — SAS 9.4 Base Procedures Guide (7e ed.), chap. 13 COMPARE Procedure, « Using the CRITERION= Option » : METHOD=ABSOLUTE « the values are unequal if |y − x| exceeds the value of CRITERION » ; OUTNOEQUAL « suppresses the writing of an observation ... when all values in the observation are judged equal » ; OUTDIF ecrit _TYPE_=DIF avec la difference y − x ; _OBS_ « is a sequence number that counts the matching observations in the BY group »

issue: sasrs #11 (sous-issue compat) — PROC COMPARE : METHOD=/CRITERION=, OUTNOEQUAL et traitement BY non implementes (filtrage des paires jugees egales divergent)
